item.title: Best Mountain & Defensive Seeds in RimWorld (1.6 & Odyssey)
item.description: Mountain seeds are great for defense-minded players. Build your base inside or against a mountain for natural choke points against raids. Use these with the current 1.6 / Odyssey version. Top Mountain Seeds SeedMap typeNotes bedrock30% coverageStrong mountain backing, single entrance defense. fortress30% coverageDeep mountain, huge interior building space. gatekeeper20% coverageTight valley, easy to wall off. item.title: RimWorld Seeds — Best World Seeds (1.6 & Odyssey)
item.description: Browse the best RimWorld seeds for the current 1.6 / Odyssey version. A good seed gives you a defensible, resource-rich map. Pick by biome to match your preferred challenge. Seeds by Biome Temperate Forest Seeds — best for beginners Mountain / Defensive Seeds Desert Seeds — hard mode Tundra & Ice Sheet Seeds — extreme How to Use a Seed When creating a new world, enter the seed code in the World Seed field and set the world size/coverage to match the seed notes.
